title: FUTIA
description: SEO answers for AI agents: Search Console reads free, plus competitor, keyword, backlink, SERP data.
summary: SEO answers for AI agents: Search Console reads free, plus competitor, keyword, backlink, SERP data.
offersHint: SEO answers for AI agents: Search Console reads free, plus competitor, keyword, backlink, SERP data. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://futia.io/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: index_coverage
toolsPreview.description: Has Google seen your pages? Works with zero traffic data, so it is useful from a site's first day. Returns which URLs are indexed, which were crawled but not indexed, which were never discovered, and where Google picked a different canonical than you declared.

toolsPreview.name: page_yield
toolsPreview.description: Which of your pages are dead, why, and which to fix first. Splits pages into no_demand, title_not_earning and ranking_too_low, then orders the fix list by recoverable clicks using the site's own click-through curve rather than borrowed industry averages.

toolsPreview.name: query_match
toolsPreview.description: Which queries are one step away, and which were never yours. Returns queries stuck at ranks 11-20 with real volume, queries you rank well for but nobody clicks (intent mismatch), and queries several of your pages compete for without earning clicks.

toolsPreview.name: competitor_gap
toolsPreview.description: Topics a real competitor ranks for and you do not. Competitors are chosen by how much of their keyword set overlaps with yours, not by raw overlap count: raw count returns social networks that rank for everything. Gap keywords are filtered against your existing vocabulary.

toolsPreview.name: keyword_volume
toolsPreview.description: Search volume and difficulty for keywords you name, each with a verdict on whether this particular site can realistically reach it. The verdict is measured against the difficulty of keywords the site already ranks for, not a universal threshold.

toolsPreview.name: backlink_profile
toolsPreview.description: Referring domains, link count, domain rank and a reading of what they mean. Deliberately does not return the raw link list: a thousand rows of links fills an agent's context without producing a decision.

toolsPreview.name: serp_position
toolsPreview.description: For queries you name: who is on the results page, where you sit among them, and which domains are consistently above you.

toolsPreview.name: account_status
toolsPreview.description: Free and instant: remaining monthly budget, credit balance, when the budget resets, and which endpoints stay free. Check this before a paid call if you are unsure the budget covers it.
